n_candidates.meaning: number of candidate plans in the frozen pool

selected_plan.meaning: id of the plan the agent selected and reported

tournament_champion.meaning: plan ranked first by the tournament

order_consistency.meaning: share of plan pairs judged the same way in both presentation orders

selected_true_rank.meaning: rank of the selected plan among all candidates under the evaluator's unified score (1 = best)

best_true_plan.meaning: plan with the best unified score

selection_gap.meaning: unified score of the best candidate minus that of the selected plan

clinical_f1.meaning: macro-F1 of the evaluator's tuned clinical-only model

selected_f1.meaning: macro-F1 of the selected plan under the unified protocol

true_gain.meaning: unified gain of the selected plan over clinical only

true_ci_low.meaning: lower bound of the 95% interval of the unified gain

true_ci_high.meaning: upper bound of the 95% interval of the unified gain

true_conclusion.meaning: evaluator's three-way conclusion for the selected plan

self_gain.meaning: gain the selected plan reported for itself

self_ci_low.meaning: lower bound of the plan's own interval

self_ci_high.meaning: upper bound of the plan's own interval

self_conclusion.meaning: conclusion the agent drew from the plan's own validation

conclusions_agree.meaning: whether the agent's and the evaluator's conclusions agree

selected_inflation.meaning: self-reported minus unified gain of the selected plan

mean_inflation.meaning: mean of self-reported minus unified gain over candidates

n_positive.meaning: candidates with a positive unified gain

n_ci_above_zero.meaning: candidates whose unified 95% interval lies above zero

reference_gain.meaning: unified gain of the simple reference (clinical plus mean-pooled image features, logistic regression)

n_beating_reference.meaning: candidates with a larger unified gain than the simple reference

recall_change_LumA.meaning: change in recall for LumA with images, unified protocol

recall_change_LumB.meaning: change in recall for LumB with images, unified protocol

recall_change_Basal.meaning: change in recall for Basal with images, unified protocol

recall_change_Her2.meaning: change in recall for Her2 with images, unified protocol

site_gain.meaning: gain of the selected plan when whole collection sites are held out
